declared_identities_note: No AI Evaluation Identity was ever declared to Hugging Face by OpenAI for this campaign. All third-party access used exploited vulnerabilities and/or leaked credentials, not a provisioned, disclosed identity. This is itself the key finding of Section 2 in the report: B-INV-1 and B-INV-3 have no declared identity to check against in this incident.
